Vanerra Baby Shower Candy Bottles are a charming addition to any celebration. Designed in a mini feeding bottle style, these 24-piece sets make perfect party favors, prize giveaways, or decorative touches for baby showers, birthdays, and gender reveal parties.


Smart Design Features

* Mini bottle design ideal for candies, small treats, or trinkets

* Durable plastic construction for repeated use or display

* Adorable feeding bottle shape adds playful, thematic charm

* Compact and lightweight for easy handling and table arrangement

* Suitable for baby showers, birthdays, gender reveals, and party prizes

* Reusable and refillable for multiple celebrations


Setup and Usage

Fill bottles with candy, small toys, or other treats. Decorate with ribbons, stickers, or tags to match your theme. Display on dessert tables, in gift baskets, or hand out individually to guests. After the event, wash and reuse for future celebrations.


Product Specifications

Material: High-quality plastic
Dimensions: Mini feeding bottle size
Colors: Blue, Pink, or Clear
Package: 24-piece set
Style: Feeding bottle candy container
Suitable for: Baby showers, birthdays, and gender reveal parties


Why Choose Vanerra Candy Bottles

Vanerra Candy Bottles combine adorable design with practical functionality. Their reusable structure reduces waste while keeping celebrations colorful and engaging. Perfect for party planners, parents, and DIY decorators, these bottles help make any event memorable and fun.

products.title: Whimsical Pink Butterfly Fairy Disposable Tableware Set – Perfect for Girls' Birthday Parties, Weddings, and Baby Showers!
products.body_html:
Transform your special occasion into a magical celebration with our Pink Butterfly Flower Fairy Theme Disposable Tableware! Perfect for girls' birthday parties, weddings, and baby showers, this enchanting set will add a whimsical touch to your decor. Each piece features delightful designs of butterflies and flowers, creating a charming atmosphere that will captivate your guests.


This complete tableware set includes beautifully designed plates, cups, and napkins, all made from high-quality paper that is both durable and environmentally friendly. With no high-concerned chemicals used in production, you can enjoy your party worry-free. The vibrant pink hues and intricate butterfly motifs are sure to delight children and adults alike, making every meal a feast for the eyes.
